## DeepSeek Harness（[deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，MIT，今天还在更新）

真实存在且不小：TypeScript/pnpm monorepo，9161 个文件，底座是 [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis)（「时空可组合」范式）。它的 harness 哲学比名字更激进——**「everything is a plugin」，连 agent loop 本身都是可替换插件**。读完 [architecture.md](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/architecture.md)，值得 aqa 借鉴的三点：

1. **事件瀑布（waterfall）当扩展点**：`agent/pre-step`（拦截器可以改写甚至拒绝模型即将看到的内容）、`tools/pre-execute`（工具执行前的守卫）、`llm/stream` 等，监听器必须 `next()` 委托——这比我们刚立项的 M-F pipeline 相位 hook 更细：**hook 链可以伸进 agent 循环内部**，不只是量化/评估相位。
2. **Profiles + bundles + patch-by-id 组合**：一次启动 = 有序层叠（bundle 列表 → profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` → 用户补丁 → `--patch` 覆盖），`dsh --dump-config` 能打印实际生效树。这正是我们要的「能力包」形态——比如一个 `diffusion pack`（一组 hooks + skills + recipe 默认）可以声明式组合、按 id 打补丁。
3. **持久会话日志连「被拒的 turn」都记录**——审计/回放友好，和我们的 ATIF 轨迹导出互补。另外它仓里的 `.agents/notes/` 全是带日期的架构决策记录（ADR），这个习惯本身也值得学。

## Codex 平台（[Codex as a platform](https://developers.openai.com/blog/codex-as-a-platform)）

博客里最有分量的是这句实证：**ARC-AGI-3 上，retained reasoning + context compaction 把 GPT-5.6 Sol 从 13.3% 拉到 38.3%，输出 token 还少了 6 倍**——「harness 设计实质改变分数」的官方实锤。三层集成面：`codex exec`（有界非交互，aqa 的 codex scaffold 已在用）、SDK、app-server（持久线程 + 流事件 + 审批）。

对 aqa 的直接映射：
- **retained reasoning + context compaction 是个独立能力组件**——我们的 E3 ReAct solver 和 fix-loop 长会话目前没有 compaction，按这个数据点，它该做成可插拔组件挂在 ReAct 循环上；
- app-server 的「interrupt/resume + 审批请求」事件面，比我们现在 `codex exec --json` 的一次性调用丰富——agent-15 正在读 codex-rs 的代码细节（sandbox/execpolicy/rollout 格式），回来后有更实的清单。

## 进设计文档的映射

M-F 的 hook 层按这两个调研升级设计：hook 语义从「相位回调」升级为**有序瀑布**（hook 可改写上下文、可否决、可短路），并引入「capability pack」概念（一组 hooks + skills + recipe 默认值的命名组合，可按需开关/打补丁）——这就是你说的「方便放更多能力进去」的组件形态。等 agent-14/15 的两份深度报告落地，我把细节合并进 M-F。

17	- `hooks/` — 生命周期 hook 引擎（schema + runtime）（[hooks crate](https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/main/codex-rs/hooks)）
18	
19	为什么说它是好 *harness* 而不仅是 agent：每一层都是独立 crate + 独立 CLI 入口（`codex execpolicy check`、`codex sandbox linux`、`codex exec --json`），policy/事件/持久化全部 schema 化（serde + JSON Schema + ts-rs 导出），headless 路径（`codex exec`）与 TUI 共用同一个 core，事件流本身就是机器可读的评测数据源。
20	
21	---
22	
23	## 1. Agent loop 架构
24	
25	- **Loop 形状**：`SessionTask` trait（`kind()` + `run()`），具体实现为 `RegularTask` / `ReviewTask` / `CompactTask` / `UserShellTask`（[core/src/tasks/](https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/main/codex-rs/core/src/tasks)、[tasks/regular.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/core/src/tasks/regular.rs)）。`RegularTask.run` 发 `TurnStarted` 事件 → 循环调 `run_turn(sess, ctx, input, ..., CancellationToken)`（[core/src/session/turn.rs](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/core/src/session/turn.rs)），turn 间检查 `input_queue.has_pending_input`（支持 steering/interrupt），`terminal_error` 置位即停。
26	- **TurnContext**：每次 turn 的不可变上下文（model client、cwd、sandbox policy、approval policy、turn 计时等），`per-turn` 重建而非全局可变（[core/src/session/turn_context.rs](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/core/src/session/turn_context.rs)）。
27	- **Tool 协议**：shell / unified_exec（PTY）、`apply_patch`（虚拟 CLI：主二进制检测到 `arg1 == --codex-run-as-apply-patch` 时变身 patch 应用器，见 [core/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/core/README.md) 与 `arg0/` crate）、web_search（`disabled|cached|indexed|live`，默认 cached 走 OpenAI 索引以降 prompt-injection 面）、MCP tools、plan/todo、多 agent collab 工具（[config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference)）。
28	- **Model client 抽象**：`model_providers.<id>` 声明式 provider（`base_url` / `env_key` / `wire_api="responses"` / `request_max_retries` / `stream_idle_timeout_ms` / `stream_max_retries`），内置 openai/ollama/lmstudio（[config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference)）；client 本体在 [core/src/client.rs](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/core/src/client.rs)（102KB，含 SSE 重试 `responses_retry.rs`）。
29	- **Hooks 已内建进 turn loop**：`run_hooks_and_record_inputs` 在 turn 输入落盘前执行（[tasks/regular.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/core/src/tasks/regular.rs)），runtime 在 [core/src/hook_runtime.rs](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/core/src/hook_runtime.rs)，EventMsg 有 `HookStarted/HookCompleted`（[rollout/src/policy.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/rollout/src/policy.rs)）。
30	
31	---
32	
33	## 2. Sandbox 模型（首要借鉴对象）
34	
35	### 2.1 两层控制：sandbox mode × approval policy
36	
37	- `sandbox_mode = read-only | workspace-write | danger-full-access`；`approval_policy = untrusted | on-request | never | { granular = {...} }`（`on-failure` **已 deprecated**）。granular 可按类别单独开关：`sandbox_approval / rules / mcp_elicitations / request_permissions / skill_approval`（[config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference)）。
38	- 新版 `[permissions.<name>]` split 文件系统策略：路径/glob → `read|write|deny`，支持 `extends`、`:workspace_roots` 作用域、嵌套 carveout（write 下再 deny、deny 下再 reopen write），不可安全执行的策略 **fail closed**（[config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference)、[core/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/core/README.md)）。
39	- workspace-write 的 protected paths：`<root>/.git`（含 `gitdir:` 指针解析目标）、`.agents`、`.codex` 递归只读（[sandbox 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/sandbox)）。
40	
41	### 2.2 Linux 执行机制（现在是 bwrap，不再是 landlock 默认）
42	
43	来自 [linux-sandbox/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/linux-sandbox/README.md)：
44	
45	- 默认 **bubblewrap**：`--ro-bind / /`（全盘只读起步）→ `--bind` 叠加 writable roots → 对 protected subpaths（`.git`/`.codex`）再 `--ro-bind`；重叠策略按 path-specificity 排序应用。
46	- `--unshare-user` + `--unshare-pid`；网络受限且无 proxy 时 `--unshare-net`；进程内 `PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS` + **seccomp 网络过滤器**。
47	- deny glob（如 `**/*.env = "none"`）在启动前用 `rg --files` 展开并 mask；writable root 内的 symlink/缺失 protected 路径用 `/dev/null` 挂载封堵。
48	- Landlock 仅作 legacy fallback（`features.use_legacy_landlock=true`）；CLI 仍叫 `codex debug landlock` / `codex sandbox linux`。
49	- 托管 proxy 模式下 `--unshare-net` + TCP→UDS→TCP 桥，桥起后 seccomp 再禁新 AF_UNIX/socketpair。
50	- macOS = Seatbelt（`sandbox-exec -p`），Windows = restricted token/elevated backend（[sandbox 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/sandbox)、[core/src/sandboxing/mod.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/core/src/sandboxing/mod.rs)）。
51	- **网络 domain 策略**（`network-proxy` crate）：allowlist-first，`*.example.com` 只管子域、`**.` 含 apex、`deny` 恒胜；默认 block loopback/private（`allow_local_binding=false`）；allow 前做 DNS/IP 分类检查防 DNS rebinding（[sandbox 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/sandbox)）。
52	
53	### 2.3 execpolicy 规则引擎（读了实际源码）
54	
55	- **文件格式**：`.rules` 文件用 **Starlark**（无副作用方言），builtins：`prefix_rule(pattern, decision?, justification?, match?, not_match?)`、`network_rule(host, protocol, decision, ...)`、`host_executable(name, paths)`（[parser.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/src/parser.rs)、[execpolicy/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/README.md)、[rules 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/rules)）。
56	- **匹配语义**：命令按 argv token 列表匹配；`pattern` 元素可为字面量或字面量列表（alternatives）；`Policy` 内部 `MultiMap<first_token, RuleRef>` 按首 token 索引；可选 basename fallback（`/usr/bin/git` → `git` 规则，受 `host_executable` 白名单约束）（[policy.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/src/policy.rs)、[rule.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/src/rule.rs)）。
57	- **Decision**：`Allow < Prompt < Forbidden`，多规则命中取 **max（最严格者胜）**（[decision.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/src/decision.rs)、[policy.rs `Evaluation::from_matches`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/src/policy.rs)）。无命中时走 `heuristics_fallback`（core 侧的可疑命令启发式，`HeuristicsRuleMatch`）。
58	- **内联单测**：`match` / `not_match` 示例在 **加载时校验**，不通过则 policy 加载失败（[rule.rs `validate_match_examples`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/src/rule.rs)）。
59	- **复合命令防走私**：`bash -lc "a && b"` 若为纯线性链（无重定向/替换/变量/glob/控制流），用 **tree-sitter** 拆成单命令逐条过规则，最严格者胜；否则整条按 `["bash","-lc",script]` 保守匹配（[rules 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/rules)）。
60	- **闭环**：审批弹窗可携带 `proposed_execpolicy_amendment`，用户接受 `ApprovedExecpolicyAmendment` 后写入 `~/.codex/rules/default.rules`，下次免问（[protocol/src/approvals.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/protocol/src/approvals.rs)、[rules 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/rules)）；admins 可从 `requirements.toml` 强制 forbidden 规则。
61	- **调试 CLI**：`codex execpolicy check --rules ... [--resolve-host-executables] -- cmd args`，输出 JSON `{matchedRules, decision}`（[execpolicycheck.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/src/execpolicycheck.rs)）。
62	
63	---
64	
65	## 3. Rollout / session 日志（对照 ATIF）
66	
67	- **文件布局**：`$CODEX_HOME/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<ts>-<thread_id>[_<rollout_id>].jsonl`（reverted thread 追加第二个 id）；可选 zstd 压缩 + 后台 compression worker；另有 SQLite state DB、session index、reverse JSONL scanner（[rollout_file_name.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/rollout/src/rollout_file_name.rs)、[rollout/src/lib.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/rollout/src/lib.rs)）。
68	- **行格式**：`RolloutLine { timestamp, ordinal?, item: RolloutItem }`；`RolloutItem = SessionMeta | ResponseItem | Compacted | TurnContext | EventMsg | WorldState | SecurityRiskScore | InterAgentCommunication | RealtimeItem`（[rollout/src/lib.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/rollout/src/lib.rs)、[rollout/src/policy.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/rollout/src/policy.rs)）。
69	- **持久化白名单**（`is_persisted_rollout_item`）：ResponseItem 里 message/reasoning/function_call/output/web_search/compaction 全存；EventMsg 里只存 durable 的（`TokenCount`、`TurnStarted`、`TurnComplete`、`ItemCompleted`(Paginated 模式)、`ThreadRolledBack`…），**transient 事件（delta、approval request、StreamError 等）一律不落盘** —— 这是"日志即恢复状态"设计的关键：rollout 既是审计日志又是 resume 的状态源（[rollout/src/policy.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/rollout/src/policy.rs)）。
70	- **Resume**：`InitialHistory / ResumedHistory` 从 rollout 重建模型上下文（[core/src/session/rollout_reconstruction.rs](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/core/src/session/rollout_reconstruction.rs)）；`codex exec resume --last | <SESSION_ID>`（[noninteractive 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/noninteractive)）；`--ephemeral` 可不写盘。
71	- **Token 核算**：`EventMsg::TokenCount` 持久化，含 total/last（`last_token_usage` 即 aqa `parse_usage_from_text` 现在抓的字段）；另有实验性 `features.rollout_budget`（token 预算 + reminder 间隔）（[config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference)）。
72	- **对 ATIF 的差距**：ATIF/aqa 目前是"评测后导出"（trajectory-cumulative，无 per-step 指标，scaffold 轨迹只有 1 个 agent step + 4000 字符尾巴，`atif.py` docstring 自述）；codex rollout 是"运行中 append-only 持久化 + 每行 timestamp/ordinal + per-turn token + 可 resume"。
73	
74	---
75	
76	## 4. `codex exec` 非交互模式与 JSON 事件
77	
78	- **事件 schema**（`--json` → stdout JSONL；progress 在 stderr，final message 可 `-o` 落盘）：`ThreadEvent = thread.started | turn.started | turn.completed{usage} | turn.failed | item.started/updated/completed | error`。`Usage { input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_write_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens }`。`ThreadItem` details：`agent_message / reasoning / command_execution{command, aggregated_output, exit_code, status} / file_change{changes[{path,kind}],status} / mcp_tool_call / web_search / todo_list / collab_tool_call / error`（完整定义：[exec/src/exec_events.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/exec/src/exec_events.rs)；渲染器：[event_processor_with_jsonl_output.rs](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/exec/src/event_processor_with_jsonl_output.rs)；官方示例：[noninteractive 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/noninteractive)）。
79	- ⚠️ 注意：当前 main 的 `turn.completed.usage` 是新 schema；aqa scaffold 抓的 `last_token_usage` 是 legacy `EventMsg::token_count`（`{"msg":{"type":"token_count","info":{"last_token_usage":...}}}`）形状。`parse_usage_from_text` 的 DFS 找 key 写法两种都能兜住，但要意识到 schema 漂移是常态。
80	- **评测向特性**：`--output-schema <json-schema>` 让 final message 变成 schema 约束的结构化输出（配合 `-o` 写文件）；`--ephemeral`；`--sandbox read-only` 是 exec 默认值；`--skip-git-repo-check`；`--ignore-user-config` / `--ignore-rules`（干净自动化环境）；`mcp_servers.<id>.required=true` 时 MCP 初始化失败即非零退出（fail-fast 依赖检查）；`codex exec resume --last` 两段式 pipeline（[noninteractive 文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/noninteractive)）。
81	- **官方没有独立 evals crate**（repo 里没有 eval 目录；评测逻辑靠 tests + `codex exec --json` 的可消费性，第三方 harness 如 [supabase/evals](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/08/01/supabase-releases-evals-an-open-source-benchmark-that-scores-claude-code-codex-and-opencode-on-real-supabase-tasks/) 就是这么驱动 Codex 的）。另有 opt-in **OTel**：`codex.conversation_starts / api_request / sse_event(含 token) / tool_decision(approved|denied, source) / tool_result`（[sandbox 文档 §telemetry](https://developers.openai.com/codex/sandbox)）。
82	
83	---
84	
85	## 5. Verdict：aqa 该借什么、跳过什么
86	
87	### 借（按优先级）
88	
89	1. **execpolicy 规则引擎 → 新模块 `aqa/sandbox/policy.py`，替换/补强 `base.py:is_unsafe_command` 的正则启发式。**
90	   - 移植语义而非实现：argv token 化（`shlex.split`，aqa 现在跑 `sh -c` 整串，需要先拆）；prefix pattern + alternatives；`allow/prompt/forbidden` 三态 + strictest-wins；`match`/`not_match` 内联单测（加载时校验，直接可做成 pytest）；rules 文件用 TOML/Python DSL 即可，**不必引 Starlark**。
91	   - 照搬"复合命令拆分"规则：`sh -c "a && b"` 只对纯线性链拆分逐条判定，否则保守整体匹配 —— 正好补上 aqa 现在正则对 `curl ... | sh` 这类拼接的脆弱性（源码依据见 §2.3）。
92	   - `approval_policy` 映射到 aqa 没有交互的场景：`prompt` 在 headless 下即 `forbidden`（codex 在 `never` 下也是这么处理的，[decision.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/execpolicy/src/decision.rs) 注释）。
93	   - 附赠 CLI：`aqa sandbox check <cmd>`（对标 `codex execpolicy check`），让规则可单测可调试。
94	
95	2. **bwrap 后端 → `aqa/sandbox/` 新增 `BwrapSandbox`（或给 `LocalSandbox` 加 `isolation="bwrap"`）。** aqa 主机是 Linux，bubblewrap 零守护、无 root 依赖（user namespace）。照搬参数模板：`--ro-bind / /` + `--bind <workdir>` + `--ro-bind` 保护 `.git`/`.codex` + `--unshare-net`（无网时）+ `--unshare-pid`；网络开关成为一等配置（对应 codex `network_access`）。这让"LocalSandbox + 正则"从 *best-effort guard* 升级为 *实际隔离*，且比 DockerSandbox 轻（依据：[linux-sandbox/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/linux-sandbox/README.md)）。deny glob（`**/*.env = "none"` → 启动前 rg 展开 + mask）对 aqa 防 API key 泄漏进沙箱特别值钱。
96	
97	3. **CodexScaffold 升级 → `aqa/agent_eval/scaffold.py`。**
98	   - `parse_usage` 增加新 schema 分支：`turn.completed.usage`（当前只认 `last_token_usage`，依据 [exec_events.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/exec/src/exec_events.rs)）。
99	   - 加 `--output-schema` 透传（`extra_args` 已支持，建议在 ScaffoldContext 加显式字段）：让 codex 直接吐结构化 verdict/summary，替代现在"output 尾巴塞 ReActStep"。
100	   - 多阶段 eval 用 `codex exec resume --last`（两段式 quant→fix pipeline 可直接复用）。
101	   - 关键改进：**别丢 rollout**。scaffold 跑完后从沙箱内 `$CODEX_HOME/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl` 捞 rollout 文件喂给 `atif.py` —— 每行 ResponseItem + TurnContext + TokenCount 就是完整逐步轨迹，直接修掉 atif.py "scaffold 只有单步摘要"的缺口（§3）。
102	
103	4. **Rollout 式持久化 → `aqa/agent_eval/atif.py` / `aqa/agent/trajectories.py`。** 借三点：append-only JSONL + 每行 `timestamp/ordinal`；durable/transient 持久化白名单（只落 token_count、turn 边界、item 完成，不落 delta）；`InitialHistory` 式 resume（aqa 的 fix_loop 重跑目前是无状态的）。per-turn usage（`turn.completed`）还能补上 ATIF per-step metrics 的空缺。
104	
105	5. **Hook 事件模型 → `aqa/hooks/`（phase-hook 层）。** codex `[hooks]` 的 taxonomy：matcher group + handler，`PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PermissionRequest/PreCompact/PostCompact/SessionStart/SessionEnd`，handler 支持 `async=true`（后台不阻塞）和 `additionalContextLimit`（hook 输出 token 上限，超出落盘只给预览）（[config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference)、[hooks crate](https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/main/codex-rs/hooks)）。aqa 现在只有 phase-boundary hook（after_quantize/after_benchmark）；值得借：(a) `async` 标志（`run_hook_chain` 目前是同步串行）；(b) 输出体积上限（防 hook 污染 fix-loop 签名）；(c) 若 aqa-react loop 要加 PreToolUse 级拦截，直接对 `react.py` 的 Command 执行点加 hook 相位，与 execpolicy 的 `prompt/forbidden` 判定天然衔接。
106	
107	6. **Token 预算 → `aqa/agent_eval/proxy.py`。** codex `features.rollout_budget`（limit_tokens + reminder_interval_tokens + prefill/sampling 权重）可映射为 ServingProxy 的 token 预算（现在只有 max_turns）；fail-closed 语义照 codex：`max_turns` 用尽抛 AqaError 已一致。
108	
109	### 跳过
110	
111	- **Rust 特有实现**：Starlark 求值器、tree-sitter 拆分器（借语义即可，Python 用 `shlex`+简单 tokenize 够 aqa 的场景）、serde/ts-rs 导出。
112	- **TUI / app-server / IDE / ChatGPT desktop**：整套 approval 人机交互、editor 集成、notifications。
113	- **MCP / connectors / multi-agent collab / memories / realtime / cloud-tasks**：aqa 无对应面。
114	- **Seatbelt/Windows sandbox**：aqa 只跑 Linux。
115	- **OTel exporter**：aqa 已有 `report/sinks.py`；只需借 `tool_decision`/`tool_result` 事件*命名*做日志规范，不必引 OTel 依赖。
116	- **`danger-full-access` 之外无中间态的老 `SandboxPolicy`**：codex 自己也在向 `[permissions]` split 策略迁移，aqa 新写就直接上 split 模型（read/write/deny per path），别抄 legacy 三档。
117	
118	### 一句话总结
119	
120	对 aqa 最值钱的不是 agent loop，而是 codex 把 harness 三件套做成了**可独立测试的 schema 化组件**：execpolicy（声明式命令规则 + 内联单测 + strictest-wins）、bwrap 沙箱参数模板（ro-bind 全盘起步 + 白名单可写 + 网络开关）、rollout（append-only JSONL 同时充当审计日志与 resume 状态）。三者分别落在 `aqa/sandbox/policy.py`（新建）、`aqa/sandbox/` bwrap 后端、`aqa/agent_eval/{scaffold,atif}.py` 的 rollout 消费链上。

4	
5	- **`aqa/hooks/__init__.py`** — `PhaseHook` runtime-checkable protocol (`name` + `after_quantize(run_cfg, quant_cfg, output_dir)` / `after_benchmark(run_cfg, recipe, result_or_exception, out_dir)`; hooks implement only the phases they care about). `DEFAULT_HOOKS = ("quant_sanity", "eval_sanity")`. `resolve_hooks(run_cfg)` resolves the chain once per distinct chain via `lru_cache` on the names tuple. `run_hook_chain(phase, chain, run_cfg=None, **ctx)`: in-order execution, DEBUG log per invocation, `AqaError` propagates (validator verdict), any other exception logged at WARNING and skipped. `run_hooks(phase, run_cfg, **ctx)` = resolve + execute.
6	- **`aqa/hooks/sanity.py`** — the two seed validators:
7	  - `QuantSanityHook.after_quantize`: collects dirs claiming auto-round (`config.json` with `quantization_config.quant_method in {"auto-round","auto_round"}` at export root / `transformer/` / `unet/`, or an `export_format: auto_round` run), then header-only safetensors reads (`safe_open`, lazy import) looking for any `qweight` tensor. No claiming config → pass (fake format); any packed weights → pass; unreadable/missing safetensors lib → pass (no guessing); else `AqaError("quantization produced 0 packed layers ...")`.
8	  - `EvalSanityHook.after_benchmark`: `Exception` inputs pass through (runner surfaces those); a `BenchmarkResult` with `score == 0` raises `AqaError("benchmark <name> scored 0 (acc=0 => fail; ...)")`.
9	- **`tests/test_hooks.py`** (18 tests) — builtins/entry-point parity (pyproject text-checked), runtime `Registry.register` dual-track, protocol conformance (full impl isinstance-True; partial impl isinstance-False, documenting the skip-semantics), config default/explicit/`[]`/unknown→`ConfigError`, quant_sanity fixtures using the real `safetensors.numpy.save_file` style from `test_export_repair.py` (LLM root + diffusion component layouts, packed/unpacked/no-config/format-claim variants), eval_sanity zero/normal/exception, crash-not-fatal + chain continues, ordering, validator aborts chain, `hooks: []` vs default via `run_hooks`, `run_quantization` integration (monkeypatched `_run_autoround`), pipeline `_run_quantize` phase failure via the hook, pipeline `_run_evaluate` phase with faked `run_fix_loop`/`run_evaluation`, and the hooks-off legacy-behavior case.
10	
11	## Files modified
12	
13	- **`aqa/registry.py`** — `_BUILTINS["aqa.hooks"]` (both seed hooks, complete mirror), `HOOKS = Registry("aqa.hooks")`, `_ALL["hooks"]`.
14	- **`pyproject.toml`** — `[project.entry-points."aqa.hooks"]` group with both hooks.
15	- **`aqa/config.py`** — `RunConfig.hooks: list[str] | None = None` (None = defaults, list = exactly those, `[]` = off) + load-time validation in `RunConfig._check` (lazy `HOOKS` import; unknown names → `ConfigError`).
16	- **`aqa/quantize/__init__.py`** — `run_quantization`/`run_quant_command` gain keyword-only `hooks: tuple | None = None` (defaults unchanged); `run_hook_chain("after_quantize", hooks, quant_cfg=…, output_dir=…)` runs after `_post_export` (`quant_cfg=None` on the command path — the hook only needs `output_dir` + optional format hint).
17	- **`aqa/pipeline.py`** — `_run_quantize` resolves the chain once and passes it on both the fix-loop `_phase` and the plain path; `_run_evaluate._phase` invokes `run_hooks("after_benchmark", …)` per benchmark result (recipe via `BenchmarkRegistry().get`) after the no-benchmarks check and before the inline all-zero check, turning a hook `AqaError` into `PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text=str(exc))`. The inline all-zero check is untouched.
18	- **`README.md`** — `aqa.hooks` row in the extension-points table, "Phase hooks: where cross-cutting capabilities plug in" paragraph at the end of the Evaluation section, `hooks/` line in the architecture tree.

22	- `~/.venv-aqa-test/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q` → **500 passed** (baseline **482**, +18 new; no existing test needed changing).
23	- `~/.venv-aqa-test/bin/python -m ruff check aqa/ tests/` → **All checks passed!**

25	## Deviations
26	
27	1. **`eval_sanity` is per-benchmark-zero, not aggregate-all-zero.** The spec text ("raises AqaError for an all-zero benchmark result") allowed both readings; per-benchmark catches the realistic silent-breakage case in multi-benchmark runs (e.g. one misconfigured diffusion benchmark amid healthy lm ones) and feeds the fix-loop per benchmark name. The pipeline's aggregate all-zero check stays verbatim, so `hooks: []` restores exact legacy behavior; no existing pipeline test produces zero scores through the phase, so nothing needed adjusting. Note the consequence: with default hooks on, a partially-zero multi-benchmark eval now fails the phase into the fix-loop (soft-fails to the last result if unresolved — existing `_run_evaluate` semantics, covered by the test).
28	2. **`after_benchmark` hooks run only in the fix-loop-wrapped `_phase`**, matching where the inline check lives; the `fix_loop: false` evaluate path bypassed *all* such checks before and still does (parity, minimal diff).
29	3. **Quantize hook ctx passes `run_cfg=None`** from `run_quantization`/`run_quant_command` (they don't receive one); the protocol tolerates it and `quant_sanity` only needs `output_dir`/`quant_cfg`. This keeps the "thread minimal context without breaking signatures" constraint.
30	4. **Unverifiable ≠ failure in `quant_sanity`** (missing safetensors lib / unreadable shard / zero shards… zero shards actually *does* fail since it's verifiably packed-free; only `None` states pass) — a validator that guesses would false-positive on exotic exports.

This is a design discussion question. They want a thoughtful discussion, not immediate implementation. Let me think carefully and honestly.

First, what is Codex's code style/design (from agent-15's research):
- Rust workspace, ~70 crates, each with independent CLI entry
- Everything schema-ized: protocol/ wire types separated from UI (serde + JSON Schema + ts-rs), events are machine-readable
- Layers: protocol / core / execpolicy / sandboxing / rollout / exec / hooks
- Durable vs transient event whitelist; rollout as append-only JSONL serving as both audit log and resume state
- TurnContext immutable per turn
- Declarative policy files with inline self-testing (match/not_match examples validated at load)
- strictest-wins policy merging
- fail-closed design ("not safely executable → deny")

aqa's current style/design:
- Python, pydantic v2 config (strict extra=forbid), entry-point plugin groups + builtins dual-track
- kernel/skills split: deterministic kernel, agent judgment in prompts/skills
- recipe YAML single source of truth
- graceful degradation everywhere (best-effort fallbacks)
- injected dependencies for tests (fast, no GPU)
- lazy heavy imports
- AqaError user-facing errors

Can/should aqa converge to Codex style? Honest discussion:

**Where convergence makes sense (philosophy-level, not language-level):**

1. **Schema-first wire types**: Codex separates protocol from everything. aqa already does this partially (pydantic configs, accuracy.json schema, manifest schema). Could push further: version every artifact schema (manifest already has schema 1.0), define explicit event/result schemas for the fix-loop and agent_eval. Pythonic equivalent: pydantic models + JSON Schema export. ✅ Worth doing.

2. **Events as the API**: Codex's durable/transient whitelist + event-sourced resume. aqa's agent_eval has ServingProxy + trajectory; fix-loop has state files. Converging means: define an explicit event taxonomy (durable vs transient), make run state reconstructible from the log (rollout-style). This aligns with our M-E work. ✅ Valuable for resume (D8).

3. **Declarative policy with inline self-validation**: execpolicy's match/not_match examples validated at load = aqa's D9 recipe CI philosophy extended to policy files. Our upcoming sandbox/policy.py should adopt this. ✅ Direct borrow already planned.

4. **Fail-closed defaults**: Codex denies when unsure. aqa's philosophy is the opposite in places — graceful degradation (best-effort fallbacks, "agent can only help never block"). Honest tension: for an eval/quant framework, silent degradation can produce silently-wrong results (tonight's 0-layer incident!). The reconciliation: fail-closed for *safety/validity* (sandbox, policy, quantization output sanity), degrade gracefully for *intelligence* (agent optional). The M-F hooks made this split explicit (validators fail, others warn). ✅ This is the key philosophical convergence worth adopting explicitly.

5. **Component = independently testable unit with own CLI**: Codex's per-crate CLIs (`codex execpolicy check`). aqa's `aqa` verbs + `aqa sandbox check` (planned) + module-level testability. Partially there.

**Where NOT to converge:**

1. **Language**: Rust vs Python — obviously not. aqa lives in the ML ecosystem (torch/vllm/diffusers are Python). No discussion needed really, but worth stating.

2. **Crate-level decomposition (70 crates)**: aqa at 11k lines doesn't need 70 packages; the module layout already has clean seams. Over-decomposition would hurt.

3. **The immutable TurnContext / actor patterns**: Rust-specific shapes; aqa's loops are fine Pythonic.

4. **Codex's approval interactivity**: aqa is headless CI-style; approval prompts don't map (prompt=forbidden headless rule already borrowed).

**What "code style" convergence would concretely mean for aqa (a charter):**
- Every cross-component contract is a pydantic schema with a version field (like manifest's schema 1.0)
- Event taxonomy: durable/transient split, explicit EventMsg equivalents in agent_eval + fix_loop
- Policy files self-validating at load (inline examples)
- Fail-closed for validity/safety, degrade for intelligence — written as an explicit principle in README/AGENTS.md
- Each plugin gets a debug CLI verb (aqa sandbox check, aqa hooks list, aqa recipes check...)

Also honest cost: aqa is 11k lines with 500 tests; a style migration has to be incremental and principle-first, not a rewrite. The four existing design docs already point this way.

## 能不能向 Codex 靠拢？我的看法：哲学层可以而且应该，实现层大部分不该

先认清两者是什么：Codex 是 ~70 个 crate 的 Rust workspace，aqa 是 11k 行 Python。「靠拢」如果理解成形态模仿（拆包、Rust 化）是错的；如果理解成**设计原则对齐**，aqa 有四处真该学，而且今晚的事故正好都是反面教材。

### 该靠拢的四条（每条今晚都有证据）

**1. Schema-first 的组件间契约**。Codex 所有跨组件类型都在独立的 `protocol/` crate，serde + JSON Schema 导出。aqa 已经做了一半（pydantic 严格 schema、manifest 有 `schema 1.0`），该推到全覆盖：accuracy.json、gate.json、trajectories.jsonl、fix-loop 的 agent 协议字段——**全部带上版本号**。成本几乎为零，收益是跨版本可复现。

**2. 事件即 API + 日志即状态**。Codex 的 rollout 是 append-only JSONL，durable/transient 白名单决定什么落盘，resume 从日志重建。aqa 的 fix-loop 重跑目前是无状态的，agent_eval 轨迹是评测后补导的——对齐这个模型，D8 的 resume 和 M-E 的轨迹会自然变简单。

**3. 策略声明化 + 加载时自校验**。execpolicy 的 `match`/`not_match` 内联示例加载不过就拒绝——这和 D9 的「recipe CI 校验」是同一哲学。即将做的 `sandbox/policy.py` 直接按这个写。

**4. 最重要的一条：fail-closed 与 degrade 的明确分工**。aqa 现在的默认哲学是「处处平滑降级」——今晚它就是因此把「0 层量化」当成成功放行了。Codex 相反：不确定就拒绝。正确的靠拢不是二选一，而是把这条写成明文原则——**安全/有效性相关的一律 fail-closed（沙箱、策略、量化产物健全性），智能相关的才允许降级（agent 缺席、知识缺失）**。M-F 的 validator/warning 二分已经是这个原则的雏形，把它升级成设计章程。

### 不该靠拢的三条

- **语言与拆分粒度**：aqa 活在 Python ML 生态（torch/vllm/diffusers），Rust 化无意义；11k 行拆 70 个包是过度设计，aqa 现有模块接缝已经足够干净。
- **不可变 TurnContext 这类 Rust 特有形态**：aqa 的循环用 Pythonic 写法就够。
- **审批交互面**：Codex 的 approval 弹窗是人机交互场景；aqa 是 headless 批处理，按 Codex 自己的规则 `prompt` 在 headless 下即 `forbidden`——这点反而说明 aqa 的默认更严格，不用动。

### 落地形态建议

不重写、不运动式改造：把这四条写成 aqa 的**架构章程**（README 设计原则节扩充，或独立的 `AGENTS.md`——正好我们一直没有），之后每个新组件按章程验收，旧代码只在被触及时顺手对齐（M-E/D8/沙箱 policy 都会自然带上）。这样「靠拢」是演化的不是革命的——以 aqa 目前的体量和 500 测试的规模，这是唯一不亏的做法。

要我把这份章程写进 `AGENTS.md`（aqa 仓根）吗？以后每个 agent（包括我）进仓第一件事就是读它。

这个问题真实存在，而且今晚就实际发生过一次：Z-Image 量化成功 → 评估时 vllm-omni 加载炸出 `adaLN_modulation.0.qweight` KeyError——**根因在量化配置**（adaLN 不该量化），但错误暴露在评估相位。今晚是我手动改 yaml 重跑的，aqa 自己确实回不去。这是当前「逐相位包裹 fix-loop」架构的真实缺口。

## 建议的设计：把线性 pipeline 改成带回退的状态机

```
quantize ──→ evaluate ──→ gate
   ↑            │
   └── rewind ──┘  (仅当证据指向量化产物)
```

**五个机制点**：

1. **回退触发靠证据分类，不是裸重试**。两级判定：先走确定性先验（正则：`KeyError.*qweight/scales`、`block_name_to_quantize` 缺失、quantization_config 与权重不一致、checkpoint 加载失败——全是产物故障的签名）；再叠加 fix-loop 已有的 agent verdict 里的 `COMPONENT` 字段（`auto_round`/`model_code` 即回退候选）。两条都不沾边才留在评估相位正常修。
2. **回退时带「证据包」回传**：评估失败的 error tail + 当前量化配置 + **「下一次必须变更」约束**（防原地重试的死循环，复用 drift 检测的同错误连击逻辑）。量化相位的 fix agent 拿到的上下文是「你量化出来的模型在评估时炸了，证据在此」——这比它在量化相位盲猜强得多。
3. **回退预算独立且小**（`max_rewinds`，默认 1–2）：量化是全 run 最贵的相位，不能无限回溯；预算耗尽 → 写回现场 + 状态标 INCONCLUSIVE/失败，交给人/更强的 tier。
4. **幂等不重跑**：baseline 评估结果、已生成的图片缓存都保留（今晚的断点续跑机制已支持），回退只重量化 + 重跑量化模型的评估。
5. **闭环会计**：manifest 的 self-heal 努力量里加 rewind 计数，让「这次 run 自愈了多少」可查。

## 一个更便宜的配套：让回退需求变少

D11 的**部署冒烟**（量化完立刻起服务打一条请求）把「加载类」故障在评估之前就拦下——那类问题根本不需要走到 eval。回退机制只留给 adaLN 这种**语义类**（能加载、但精度/行为不对）和冒烟漏网的加载问题。两个机制是互补的，先冒烟、再回退。

## 验收用例现成

今晚的 adaLN 事故就是完美回归 fixture：评估报 `KeyError: layers.29.adaLN_modulation.0.qweight` → 状态机回退到量化相位 → 修复（`--ignore_layers adaLN_modulation`）→ 评估通过。单测全 fake 可做。

The user raises a real pain point: aqa's pipeline runs quantize → eval sequentially. When eval fails and the root cause is actually a bad quantized model, the current fix-loop can't go BACK to the quantize phase — the fix-loop is per-phase. How to handle this?

Let me think about what's actually in the code and what the right design is.

Current state (from my knowledge of the codebase):
- pipeline.py phases: baseline eval → provider resolve (quantize) → evaluate → gate → manifest → sinks
- fix_loop wraps each phase separately (run_fix_loop per phase)
- Tonight's real example of this exact problem: the adaLN KeyError at evaluate phase was caused by quantization choices (adaLN quantized when vllm-omni wants it fp16). The fix was a quantize-config change (--ignore_layers adaLN_modulation) — i.e., an eval-phase failure whose fix belongs to the quantize phase. Tonight I fixed it manually by editing the yaml and re-running everything.

So the user wants: cross-phase fix-loop — when eval fails with evidence pointing at a quantization artifact/config problem, the loop should rewind to quantize with that evidence, re-quantize with a fix, then re-run eval.

Design considerations:

1. **Evidence-based rewind**: the eval failure must carry/derive a diagnosis that the artifact is at fault. Signals:
   - vllm-omni/vllm load errors KeyError for quantized weights (checkpoint content problem)
   - all-zero scores / garbage outputs (silent quant corruption)
   - deploy smoke failures (D11)
   - The new hooks (quant_sanity, eval_sanity) already catch some of this at the right phase, reducing rewind need. But semantic issues (adaLN) only surface at eval.

2. **Mechanism**: a phase-level state machine instead of linear: quantize → eval → (on artifact-fault evidence) → back to quantize with accumulated context (what failed, what was tried), with a rewind budget (max_rewinds) to avoid infinite loops. The fix-loop's drift/escalation machinery can be reused: rewind is essentially "escalate backward in the pipeline".

3. **Idempotency/caching**: re-running quantize must not redo everything — checkpoint exists; the fix typically changes config (ignore_layers etc.) → re-quantize needed (RTN is cheap ~3 min; tuned is expensive). Resume for eval phases (image caches) already helps.

4. **Classification**: how to decide "this is a quant problem" vs "eval infra problem" vs "model too weak"? The drift classifier + the agent's ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS (component field!) — prompt.py already has COMPONENT enum including auto_round/vllm_omni/model_code. When component ∈ {auto_round, quantized artifact} → rewind candidate. Plus deterministic priors: KeyError on `.qweight` / quantization_config mismatch → artifact fault.

5. **What gets carried back**: the error evidence + what the current quant config was + a constraint that the next attempt must differ (avoid identical retry loop — like the drift detector does with same-error streak).

Implementation sketch in aqa terms:
- pipeline.py: wrap quantize+evaluate in a supervision loop with `max_rewinds` (default 1-2): on evaluate PhaseResult failure, run a classifier `is_quant_artifact_fault(error_text)` (deterministic regexes first: KeyError.*qweight/scales, block_name_to_quantize, quantization config mismatches, checkpoint load errors; plus agent verdict component==auto_round). If yes → go back to quantize phase with the failure context injected into the fix-loop's operator context (the fix agent for quantize gets "eval failed with X after your quantization" context + must-change constraint). If no → normal eval fix-loop.
- The quantize fix-loop already has tiers/attempts; the rewind adds outer attempts with its own budget; manifest records rewind count (self-heal effort accounting exists).
- Gate stays the final arbiter.

Also worth noting: tonight's adaLN incident is the perfect regression test fixture (eval KeyError → rewind → quantize with --ignore_layers adaLN_modulation → eval passes).

Also alternative/complementary cheaper mitigations worth mentioning:
- D11 deploy smoke (load test right after quantize) catches artifact load failures BEFORE eval — reduces rewinds to semantic-only cases. Already planned.
- recipe pins: once a (model, scheme) recipe is validated end-to-end (gate GO), pin it (D1) so later runs skip the fault entirely.

The user's question is a design discussion ("这个应该怎么处理呢"). I should discuss + propose the design, and given the session pattern, offer to implement. Where does it land in the plan? It's a pipeline-level feature — add to design doc as its own item (maybe M-G "跨相位回退" or fold into M-C 量化深化). Let me also tie to existing concepts: drift detection, escalation, knowledge.

357	    def _replay_reference(self, error_text: str, *, max_candidates: int = 2,
358	                          inline_threshold: int = 1500, total_budget: int = 3000) -> str:
359	        """Format recorded fixes for THIS failure as agent *reference* (Option A).
360	
361	        We deliberately do NOT auto-apply recorded patches: a diff captured on a
362	        different model/checkpoint can silently break the environment, and the
363	        revert path is itself risky. Instead the best-matching recorded diffs +
364	        their provenance are handed to the agent, which decides whether the
365	        mechanism applies to the current model/checkpoint and adapts or ignores it.
366	
367	        To keep the prompt lean, only SMALL diffs are inlined; a large (e.g.
368	        multi-file source) patch is summarised (files touched, +/- line counts)
369	        with a pointer to its on-disk path for the agent to read on demand -- never
370	        hard-truncated mid-hunk. A running ``total_budget`` caps inlined bytes so
371	        two large candidates cannot both bloat the prompt. Returns "" when replay
372	        is disabled, there is no knowledge store, or nothing matches.
373	        """
374	        if not (self.replay and self.knowledge):
375	            return ""
376	        try:
377	            records = self.knowledge.find_patches(self.phase_name, error_text)
378	        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - lookup is best-effort
379	            _log.warning("replay: lookup failed: %s", exc)
380	            return ""
381	        blocks: list[str] = []
382	        remaining = total_budget
383	        for rec in records[:max_candidates]:
384	            prov = (f"model={rec.model_id or '?'} scheme={rec.scheme or '?'} "
385	                    f"class={rec.error_class or '?'} sig={rec.sig_hash}")
386	            diff = rec.diff_text(max_chars=inline_threshold + 1)
387	            if diff and len(diff) <= inline_threshold and len(diff) <= remaining:
388	                remaining -= len(diff)
389	                blocks.append(f"### candidate ({prov})\n```diff\n{diff}\n```")
390	            else:
391	                # Too big to inline: summarise + point the agent at the patch on disk.
392	                paths = ", ".join(rec.patch_paths())
393	                blocks.append(
394	                    f"### candidate ({prov})\n{rec.stat_summary()}\n"
395	                    f"full patch on disk (READ it if the mechanism looks relevant): {paths}")
396	        if not blocks:
397	            return ""
398	        _log.info("replay: injecting %d recorded fix(es) as reference for %s "
399	                  "(no auto-apply)", len(blocks), self.phase_name)

`build_fix_prompt` assembles (prompt.py:73-163):

## Assessment: is it sufficient?

The design is actually quite good — better than typical. The distilled + authoritative split (agent claims vs harness truth) is exactly right, and the diff consolidation across tiers is right. The prompt even tells the next agent where the full transcripts live.

**But there are real gaps I can point to with evidence:**

1. **Error evolution is invisible.** The next attempt sees only the LATEST error tail + `actual_class` of the previous rerun. What it can't see: how the error *changed* across attempts (e.g. error moved from model_load → CUDA OOM → KeyError deeper in the stack = progress!). The drift logic measures this internally (`prev_text` similarity at fix_loop.py:538) but doesn't surface the trajectory of errors to the agent. A "error history so far: [class sequence]" line would be nearly free and high value.

2. **Agent's reasoning between parsed fields is lost unless it goes to read the files.** `agent_summary` is capped at 200 chars and only carries root_cause/fix_plan. The agent's EVIDENCE_CMD results (what it actually observed when probing) — the meatiest part — are only reachable via file pointers, and whether the next agent actually reads them is up to the agent. For cheap tiers (weak models), they likely don't.

3. **Environment side effects outside the 3 tracked patch areas are invisible.** patch_capture snapshots auto_round/vllm/transformers_modules. If the agent edited a run yaml, installed/uninstalled a package, or set an env var in a previous attempt, the next attempt doesn't know. The diff block says "on disk now" but only for those areas.

4. **No "what was already ruled out" within THIS run.** rejected_trail accumulates within the run but is only persisted to the trajectory store on SUCCESS (for future runs). The NEXT attempt within the same run doesn't see the rejected hypotheses list — it sees the prior attempt's one summary line. So attempt 3 can re-try attempt 1's rejected hypothesis. The trajectory playbook covers past runs, not this run's dead ends. This is a real sufficiency gap: in-run dead-end memory.

Cross-phase continuity is absent by design (that's the rewind discussion).

This is the classic transformers "load with mismatched head/aux" warning table. Analysis:

1. `relative_position_index` UNEXPECTED: relative_position_index is a **non-persistent buffer** in newer transformers versions — it's computed on the fly, not stored. The checkpoint (trained with an older timm/transformers convention) stores it; the current model doesn't register it as a parameter/buffer → "unexpected". Ignorable — the model recomputes it.

2. `swin.layernorm.weight/bias` MISSING: a final layernorm in the Swin encoder that exists in the transformers implementation but isn't in the COCO instance-segmentation checkpoint (Mask2Former checkpoints often omit it or the variant differs). It's initialized fresh (default LayerNorm init: weight=1, bias=0 — identity transform!). For LayerNorm, weight=1/bias=0 initialization is exactly identity, so a missing final LN has essentially no effect on outputs... except without learned affine params it's equivalent to the checkpoint's behavior if the checkpoint didn't have that LN. Hmm — actually if the original model HAS that LN with learned params and the checkpoint lacks it, using identity would change outputs slightly. But more likely the HF implementation registers an extra layernorm that the official mmdet checkpoint doesn't use.

import argparse
import os
import os.path as osp
import time
from collections import defaultdict

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
from accelerate import Accelerator
from accelerate.utils import gather_object
from PIL import Image
from tqdm import tqdm


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="DPG-Bench evaluation.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--image-root-path",
        type=str,
        default=None,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--resolution",
        type=int,
        default=None,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--csv",
        type=str,
        default='./dpg_bench/dpg_bench.csv',
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--res-path",
        type=str,
        default=None,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--pic-num",
        type=int,
        default=1,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--vqa-model",
        type=str,
        default='mplug',
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()
    return args


class MPLUG(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ckpt='damo/mplug_visual-question-answering_coco_large_en', device='gpu'):
        super().__init__()
        from modelscope.pipelines import pipeline
        from modelscope.utils.constant import Tasks
        self.pipeline_vqa = pipeline(Tasks.visual_question_answering, model=ckpt, device=device)

    def vqa(self, image, question):
        input_vqa = {'image': image, 'question': question}
        result = self.pipeline_vqa(input_vqa)
        return result['text']

def prepare_dpg_data(args):
    previous_id = ''
    current_id = ''
    question_dict = dict()
    category_count = defaultdict(int)
    # 'item_id', 'text', 'keywords', 'proposition_id', 'dependency', 'category_broad', 'category_detailed', 'tuple', 'question_natural_language'
    data = pd.read_csv(args.csv)
    for i, line in data.iterrows():
        if i == 0:
            continue

        current_id = line.item_id
        qid = int(line.proposition_id)
        dependency_list_str = line.dependency.split(',')
        dependency_list_int = []
        for d in dependency_list_str:
            d_int = int(d.strip())
            dependency_list_int.append(d_int)

        if current_id == previous_id:
            question_dict[current_id]['qid2tuple'][qid] = line.tuple
            question_dict[current_id]['qid2dependency'][qid] = dependency_list_int
            question_dict[current_id]['qid2question'][qid] = line.question_natural_language
        else:
            question_dict[current_id] = dict(
                qid2tuple={qid: line.tuple},
                qid2dependency={qid: dependency_list_int},
                qid2question={qid: line.question_natural_language})
        
        category = line.question_natural_language.split('(')[0].strip()
        category_count[category] += 1
        
        previous_id = current_id

    return question_dict

def crop_image(input_image, crop_tuple=None):
    if crop_tuple is None:
        return input_image

    cropped_image = input_image.crop((crop_tuple[0], crop_tuple[1], crop_tuple[2], crop_tuple[3]))

    return cropped_image

def compute_dpg_one_sample(args, question_dict, image_path, vqa_model, resolution):
    generated_image = Image.open(image_path)
    crop_tuples_list = [
        (0,0,resolution,resolution),
        (resolution, 0, resolution*2, resolution),
        (0, resolution, resolution, resolution*2),
        (resolution, resolution, resolution*2, resolution*2),
    ]

    crop_tuples = crop_tuples_list[:args.pic_num]
    key = osp.basename(image_path).split('.')[0]
    value = question_dict.get(key, None)

import json, sys

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from PIL import Image
from transformers import AutoImageProcessor, Mask2FormerForUniversalSegmentation

from aqa.eval.geneval import GenevalScorer, load_classnames, filter_detections, evaluate

NAME = "facebook/mask2former-swin-small-coco-instance"
proc = AutoImageProcessor.from_pretrained(NAME)
model = Mask2FormerForUniversalSegmentation.from_pretrained(NAME).cuda().eval()
scorer = GenevalScorer()  # for classnames + evaluate()
CLS = scorer.classnames
ALIASES = {"aeroplane":"airplane","diningtable":"dining table","keyboard":"computer keyboard",
           "motorbike":"motorcycle","mouse":"computer mouse","pottedplant":"potted plant",
           "remote":"tv remote","sofa":"couch","tvmonitor":"tv"}
id2label = model.config.id2label

def detect_v2(filepath):
    image = Image.open(filepath)
    inputs = proc(images=image, return_tensors="pt").to("cuda")
    with torch.no_grad():
        out = model(**inputs)
    class_probs = out.class_queries_logits[0].softmax(-1)[:, :-1]  # (Q, C)
    scores, labels = class_probs.max(-1)                            # (Q,)
    masks_logits = out.masks_queries_logits[0]                      # (Q, h, w)
    masks = F.interpolate(masks_logits[None], size=image.size[::-1], mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)[0]
    per_class = {}
    for q in range(masks.shape[0]):
        label = id2label.get(int(labels[q]))
        label = ALIASES.get(label, label)
        if label not in CLS:
            continue
        binary = masks[q].sigmoid() > 0.5
        ys, xs = binary.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        if xs.numel() == 0:
            continue
        box = [xs.min().item(), ys.min().item(), xs.max().item(), ys.max().item(), float(scores[q])]
        per_class.setdefault(label, []).append((box, binary.cpu().numpy()))
    return image, per_class

        """Run the detector; return ``(image, per_class)`` raw detections.

        Query-level extraction from the raw outputs (bypasses the HF

        HF's segment score is class_prob x mask_quality, which deflates scores and
        breaks GenEval's calibrated thresholds, esp. counting@0.9), mask = the
        query's own binary map (no argmax pixel-stealing), box = mask bounding
        rect in the official ``[x0, y0, x1, y1, score]`` shape.
        """
        self._load_detector()
        import torch
        import torch.nn.functional as F
        from PIL import Image, ImageOps

        image = ImageOps.exif_transpose(Image.open(filepath))
        inputs = self._det_processor(images=image, return_tensors="pt").to(
            self._resolve_device()
        )
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = self._detector(**inputs)
        class_probs = outputs.class_queries_logits[0].softmax(-1)[:, :-1]  # (Q, C)
        scores, labels = class_probs.max(-1)  # (Q,)
        masks_logits = outputs.masks_queries_logits[0]  # (Q, h, w)
        masks = F.interpolate(
            masks_logits[None], size=image.size[::-1], mode="bilinear",
            align_corners=False,

            ys, xs = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

## Overview

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a
multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters,
including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B
parameters per token.

The architecture combines four main ideas:

- **GDN + QSA:** three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet to compress history;
the fourth uses Qwen Sparse Attention for precise long-range retrieval.
- **Gated Residual:** four residual branches dynamically control cross-layer reads
and writes.
- **N-gram Embedding:** a 51B lookup memory adds capacity with little per-token
compute and can be asynchronously offloaded to host memory. (note that offload
currently only runs on Nvidia devices)
- **MTP:** the built-in Multi-Token Prediction module supports speculative decoding.

The checkpoint natively supports 262,144 tokens. Qwen reports that QSA reaches up
to 10.2x prefill and 6.6x decode attention-kernel speedups at one million tokens.
On GB300, TP2 is the minimum validated FP8 deployment and TP4 is the recommended
full-tray configuration. On an 8x H200 node, use TEP8 for the official FP8
checkpoint; plain TP8 is incompatible with its 128-wide quantization blocks.

## Prerequisites

- **Runtime:** use `vllm/vllm-openai:qwen38-flash-next`. PyPI installation is
not supported for this recipe.
- **Hardware:** NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm instructions are provided below.
- **FP8 memory:** the checkpoint is 172.78 GiB. TP2 is the validated minimum on
GB300; TP4 is the recommended full-tray configuration.
- **BF16 memory:** the checkpoint is 335.28 GiB. The validated TP2 configuration
used about 190 GiB per GB300 GPU.
- **Host memory for N-gram Embedding offload:** at least 51 GB plus
runtime headroom.

The Install block above generates the pull and Docker launch flow for the dedicated
image.

## Serving

### Recommended FP8 configuration on 4x GB300

Use the official
`Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8`
checkpoint tested by this recipe.

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --max-num-seqs 256 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3

```

TP2 is the minimum FP8 deployment on GB300. TP4 and TEP4 are validated
full-tray configurations, including with MTP3. Enable expert parallelism with
`--enable-expert-parallel` to improve throughput.

To serve BF16, use the `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next` checkpoint with the same
arguments.

### Recommended FP8 configuration on 8x H200

Use TEP8 with the Triton MoE backend on Hopper:

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --max-num-seqs 256 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3

```

Plain TP8 is incompatible with the FP8 checkpoint; use TEP8.

### FP8 configuration on a 4x MI355X GPU

```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0

vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \
--tensor-parallel-size 4 \
--max-model-len auto \
--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9

```

### Full native context

The checkpoint advertises a native 262,144-token context, which vLLM uses when
`--max-model-len` is omitted. Startup and bounded evaluation were validated with
this limit configured, but a single 262K-token request was not tested.

### MTP speculative decoding

Add the following option:

```bash
--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'

```

### Offload the 51B N-gram embedding table

Builds containing N-gram Embedding offload can keep the N-gram lookup
memory in host RAM and asynchronously prefetch the required rows. The initial
implementation supports both ModelRunner V1 and V2. PLE CPU offload is optional
for TP and TEP, but required for DEP. The DEP strategy generated by this recipe
enables it automatically.

```bash
VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1 \
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3

```

### Extend to one million tokens with YaRN

The checkpoint is native at 262K. For a one-million-token workload, enable static
YaRN explicitly; evaluate shorter-context quality before using this as the default.

```bash
VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1 \
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --rope-scaling '{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":4.0,"original_max_position_embeddings":262144}' \
  --max-model-len 1000000 \
  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3

```

## Verifying

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="EMPTY", base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8",
    messages=[{
        "role": "user",
        "content": "Explain how Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention complement each other.",
    }],
    max_tokens=8196,
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

```

A correct response should explain that GDN maintains a compact recurrent summary,
while QSA selectively retrieves important regions from the full token history.

## Troubleshooting

- **FP8 on eight GPUs:** use TEP8; plain TP8 is incompatible with this
checkpoint. TP4 is also supported if GPU memory capacity allows.
- **TP1 compilation OOM on GB300:** use TP2 or TP4.
- **Mamba-cache capacity error at startup:** keep `--max-num-seqs 256`.
- **Runtime OOM on large multimodal batches:** keep `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.90`.
- **Out of memory while loading:** enable N-gram Embedding CPU offload, increase
TP size, or reduce `--max-model-len` to reserve less KV cache.
- **XPU/TPU startup error:** these platforms are not supported by the initial
implementation.
- **Pipeline-parallel startup error:** N-gram Embedding does not initially support
pipeline parallelism; use single-node TP or TEP instead.
- **DEP startup failure:** DEP requires `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1`; DEP without PLE
offload is not supported. The generated DEP command sets this automatically.
- **MTP memory pressure:** reduce `num_speculative_tokens` below 3.
- **PLE:** a network layer that injects N-gram Embeddings into the main model.

{"content": "# Day-0 量化支持 Recipe：新模型 × 官方 vLLM 未支持时的分析与做法

> 2026-08-26，实证案例：Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（Qwen4 架构预览，vllm 官方 release 未支持，仅定制镜像/未合并 PR 可用）。
> 本文回答：遇到「官方 vllm release 不支持」时**怎么分析、怎么决策、怎么做、怎么沉淀**。

## 0. 问题判定（先确认真的不支持）

1. **读模型 config.json**（不用下权重）：`architectures` + `model_type` 是唯一锚点。例：Qwen3.8-Flash-Next → `Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration` / `qwen4_exp`——名字里带 "Next" 不代表是 qwen3_next；**名字会骗人，config 不会**。
2. **查本地 vllm 注册表**：`vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py` 有没有这个类名；`docs.vllm.ai` 的 supported_models 页面只能当旁证（它跟 release 走，不跟 PR 走）。
3. **判定「未支持」的语义分层**：① release 已有 → 直接用；② 已合 main 未发版 → 源码构建 main；③ PR open 未合 → 走 §2 决策矩阵；④ 没有 PR → 自己实现（vllm model plugin 机制，最贵）。

## 1. 定位支持代码在哪（信息源优先级）

1. **HF model card** 的部署段（给的镜像 tag / 命令是作者意图的最直接表达）；
2. **recipes.vllm.ai** 的 per-model recipe 页（含经验证的 serve 参数、内存数据、TP/TEP 约束、已知坑——本次直接给出 "PyPI installation is not supported"，一句话排除了 release 路线）；
3. **vllm PR 搜索**：`api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo:vllm-project/vllm+<model_type或模型名>`——本次搜出 #53896（模型支持）+ #53899（PLE offload）+ #53908（aux-GPU offload）三个 open PR；
4. **docker tag 元数据**（`hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/.../tags/<tag>` 的 last_updated）= 新鲜度信号（本次 tag 当天更新 = 活跃构建）。

## 2. 决策矩阵（实证后的规则）

| PR diff 面 | 判定 | 做法 |
|---|---|---|
| 只加模型文件 + 注册表 + 纯 Python | 可 patch | diff 打到本地 site-packages（留 `.bak`，记 patch 文件） |
| 含 scheduler/KV-cache/custom-ops 核心改动，或新增 `.cu` kernel | **不可 patch**（编译 + 核心语义风险） | **从 PR 分支源码构建专用 venv**（见 §3） |
| 官方提供定制镜像且有 docker 权限 | 最省 | 直接 `docker run vllm/vllm-openai:<tag>` |
| 以上都不行 | 最后手段 | 用 HF transformers 路径评估（慢但通用）或等合并 |

本次实判：PR 含 `csrc/libtorch_stable/gdn/fused_gdn_decode_kernel.cu`（新 CUDA kernel）+ `_custom_ops.py`/scheduler 核心改动（+19970/-449、111 文件）→ patch 否决，走源码构建。

## 3. 源码构建专用 venv 的操作要点（实证）

- 新 venv 独立（**绝不在主 venv 上动 vllm**——主 venv 里跑着的其他模型不能陪葬）；`pip install torch`（与主环境同驱动系）+ `cmake ninja` + `git clone --depth 1 -b <pr-branch> <pr-head-repo>` + `MAX_JOBS=<核数/3> pip install -e . --no-build-isolation`；
- 前置检查：`nvcc` 存在（pip 版 CUDA toolkit 的 `nvidia/cu13/bin/nvcc` 即可）、gcc 版本、内存余量（编译 vllm 全套 kernel 很吃 RAM，192 核机器 MAX_JOBS 别拉满防 OOM）；
- 构建后冒烟：`ModelRegistry.get_supported_archs()` 里确认新架构注册成功；
- **patch 记录义务**：分支名 + PR 号 + 构建日志归档（本次：`peakcrosser7/vllm@release/qwen38next` ↔ vllm#53896）；PR 合并进 release 后立即切回官方 vllm，删专用 venv。

## 4. 量化侧的 day-0 检查点

1. **auto-round 认不认这个架构**：新架构大多走通用 Linear 路径即可；MoE router/gate 自动忽略（special_model_handler）；但**新层型要过一遍已知坑清单**：线性注意力（GDN）的小投影（in_proj_a/b 这类 N=64 的）在 MXFP8 下有 `mm_mxfp8 N>=128` 约束——W4A16（INT4, group 128）无此约束，**day-0 首选 W4A16**；
2. **导出格式 vs 推理加载的配套**：compressed-tensors（llm_compressor）需要 PR 侧模型实现认 CT 量化配置；auto_round 格式需要 INC 路径支持——**新架构 PR 的量化加载支持通常滞后**，必须把「量化产物加载冒烟」列为最早验证项（见 §5）；
3. **巨型附加件**（51B N-gram 嵌入表这类）：嵌入表不参与 Linear 量化（自动忽略），但它占显存的大头之一——资源估算时单独算（bf16 常驻 ~102GB，或走 PLE CPU offload）。

## 5. 验证顺序（成本递增，任何一步不过就不往下走）

1. config 解析 + registry 注册确认（秒级）；
2. **bf16 单请求冒烟**（`vllm serve` 起服务打一条 chat）——证明推理路径通；
3. **量化产物加载冒烟**——证明量化格式被该架构认（风险最高的一步，放最前）；
4. 小 limit 评估（piqa limit 16 之类）；
5. 全量基准 + gate。

## 6. 沉淀义务（每次 day-0 都要还）

- 踩坑进 `aqa/agent/recipes/fix_playbook.md`（机制级，带错误签名）；
- 量化命令进 `recipes/quant/<model>.json`（pinned recipe，D1 闭环后自动）；
- 本情形的方法论更新进本文；
- patch/构建记录随 run 的 manifest 归档。

## 7. 本次实证时间线与结果（待实跑补全）

- 判定：`qwen4_exp` 不在 vllm 0.26.0 注册表；recipe 明示 PyPI 不支持；PR #53896 open；
- 决策：源码构建专用 venv（`~/.venv-qwen38next`），aqa `executor.env.type=venv` 派发；
- 量化：`scheme=W4A16 method=model_free export=llm_compressor`，eval 四基准（piqa/hellaswag/mmlu/gsm8k）+ bf16 TP4 baseline + gate 1%；
- 实跑结果：**待补**（量化通过率、量化产物加载冒烟、baseline vs 量化分值、gate 判定）。

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to ANY AGENTS when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## Project
6	
7	AutoRound — post-training quantization for LLMs/VLMs using sign-gradient descent. Publishes as `auto-round` (GPU/CPU) and `auto-round-hpu` (Intel Gaudi).
8	
9	## Build & Install
10	
11	```bash
12	# From source (GPU/CPU) — --no-build-isolation is required when PyTorch is already installed
13	pip install --no-build-isolation -e .
14	
15	# HPU variant
16	BUILD_HPU_ONLY=1 pip install --no-build-isolation .
17	# or: python setup.py hpu install
18	
19	# XPU variant — install Intel PyTorch first
20	pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu
21	pip install --no-build-isolation .
22	```
23	
24	## Testing
25	
26	Tests are split into three tiers under `test/`: `unit/` (fast, runs in PR CI),
27	`integration/` (third-party frameworks, runs nightly), and `e2e/` (full models /
28	real inference engines, runs weekly). Each tier is further split by hardware
29	(`test_cpu/`, `test_cuda/`, `test_hpu/`, `test_xpu/`, `test_ark/`, `test_mlx/`).
30	
31	```bash
32	# CPU unit tests (most common during development)
33	pytest test/unit/test_cpu/ -x -q
34	
35	# Single test
36	pytest test/unit/test_cpu/ -k "test_name" -x -q
37	
38	# Hardware-specific unit tests
39	pytest test/unit/test_cuda/
40	pytest test/unit/test_hpu/ --mode=lazy   # or --mode=compile
41	pytest test/unit/test_xpu/
42	
43	# Slower suites (nightly / weekly)
44	pytest test/integration/test_cpu/
45	pytest test/e2e/test_cpu/
46	```
47	
48	Test fixtures create tiny models (OPT-125M, Qwen-0.6B) at session scope — first run downloads them.
49	
50	## Code Style
51	
52	- **Line length: 120** (non-default) — enforced by black, isort, ruff, pylint
53	- **Formatter: black** (profile used by isort)
54	- **Import sorting: isort** with `profile=black`, first-party: `auto_round`, `auto_round_extension`
55	- **Linter: ruff** — rules `E4, E7, E9, F, NPY, FURB`; E501/E402/F401/F403 are intentionally ignored
56	- **License header**: Apache 2.0 auto-inserted into `.py/.yaml/.yml/.sh` under `auto_round/` and `auto_round_extension/`
57	- Pre-commit config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`
58	
59	## Commit & PR Conventions
60	
61	- Conventional commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`
62	- PRs target `main`, squash-merged
63	- **CN docs rule**: any change to a `.md` file must include a matching update to its `_CN` counterpart (e.g., `README.md` → `README_CN.md`)
64	
65	## Key Environment Variables
66	
67	- `BUILD_HPU_ONLY=1` — build HPU package variant
68	- `AR_USE_MODELSCOPE=1` — use ModelScope instead of HuggingFace for model downloads
69	- `FORCE_BF16=1` — force BF16 in tests (used in CI)
70	
71	## Source Layout
72	
73	- `auto_round/` — core library (AutoRound class, sign-SGD, exporters, eval, data types)
74	- `auto_round_extension/` — hardware backends (CUDA, HPU, IPEX/XPU, Triton, ARK, vLLM)
75	- `test/` — tests organized by tier then hardware: `unit/` (PR CI), `integration/` (nightly), `e2e/` (weekly), each with `test_cpu/`, `test_cuda/`, ...
76	- `examples/` — usage examples for different model types
77	
78	## Gotchas
79	
80	- `setup.py` forces `CC=CXX=g++` at import time
81	- Version is computed dynamically from git tags — untagged commits produce dev versions
82	- Some test dependencies (AutoAWQ, GPTQModel, llama-cpp) require manual git installs — see comments in `test/unit/test_cuda/requirements.txt`

# Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next · Hugging Face

This repository contains model weights and configuration files for the post-trained model in the Hugging Face Transformers format. 
These artifacts are compatible with Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed, etc.


For users seeking managed, scalable inference without infrastructure maintenance, the official Qwen API service is provided by Qwen Cloud.
In particular, Qwen3.8-Flash is the official version based on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with more production features, e.g., 1M context length by default, official built-in tools. For more information, please refer to the Qwen3.8-Flash Overview.

As the frontier of foundation models pushes toward ever-larger parameter counts and ever-longer context windows, the question is no longer just how much we can scale, but how efficiently we can do so. Sustainable progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits everyone demands architectural innovation. Today, we are sharing a concrete step in that direction: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. 

This experimental preview of the architecture that will underpin Qwen4 is built around a fundamental rethinking of how the core components of modern large language models (LLMs) interact at scale.

	
		
	
	
		Highlights
	

The first open-weight release under this architecture is Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, which introduces:

Hybrid Attention with QSA: The Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention pairing has been reworked into Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA). Rather than selecting individual tokens for processing, QSA operates at the micro-block level. This cuts long-context latency significantly, a critical gain as agentic workloads increasingly dominate real-world usage.
Gated Residual: Residual streams with normalization are what make deep LLM training manageable. Gated Residual modulates information flowing through widened residual streams via an element-wise, data-dependent read gate and a per-branch scalar write gate. This brings finer-grained expressiveness across layers while preserving training stability and keeping inference overhead low.
N-gram Embedding: Embeddings provide a unique axis for parameter scaling that requires less computation and is more amenable to offloading than Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). By indexing with short n-grams, this approach makes parameter scaling highly efficient for memory-constrained accelerators without sacrificing quality.
Tailored Training Recipe: The Muon and AdamW optimizers are applied to specific weight categories to maximize efficiency. Guided by refitted scaling laws, we eliminate traditional batch-size warmups and start directly at the target batch size, substantially reducing total optimizer steps while safely supporting larger learning rates for robust convergence.

For more details, please refer to our blog post Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and the technical report.
We are excited to embark on this next chapter with you and welcome your feedback as we build what comes next.

Training Stage: Pre-training & Post-training
Language Model
Number of Parameters: 125B with 6B activated, plus 51B n-gram embedding and 4B MTP
Hidden Dimension: 2560

Number of Layers: 48

Gated DeltaNet:
Number of Linear Attention Heads: 48 for V and 16 for QK
Head Dimension: 128


Qwen Sparse Attention:
Number of Attention Heads: 24 for Q and 2 for KV

		Quickstart
	

For streamlined integration, we recommend using Qwen3.8-Flash-Next via APIs.

	
		
	
	
		Serving Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
	


Inference efficiency and throughput vary significantly across frameworks. 
We recommend using the latest framework versions to ensure optimal performance and compatibility.
For production workloads or high-throughput scenarios, dedicated serving engines such as SGLang, KTransformers or vLLM are strongly recommended.

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next can be deployed with popular inference frameworks, e.g.:

SGLang: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Cookbook
vLLM: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Recipe
TokenSpeed: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Recipe


	
		
	
	
		API Usage
	


Qwen3.8-Flash-Next models operate in thinking mode by default, generating thinking content signified by <think>\n...</think>\n\n before producing the final responses.
To disable thinking content and obtain direct response, refer to the examples here.


We recommend using the following sets of sampling parameters for generation:

Thinking Mode: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=0.0, repetition_penalty=1.0
Instruct (or non-thinking) mode: temperature=0.7, top_p=0.80, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5, repetition_penalty=1.0

Please note that the support for sampling parameters varies according to inference frameworks.


In multi-turn agentic tasks, lower reasoning effort does not always reduce overall task completion time. Although it may produce faster per-turn responses, it can also lead to insufficient analysis, more failures, and repeated retries, which may increase total latency and token consumption.

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next supports controlling thinking behavior via enable_thinking, preserve_thinking, and reasoning_effort.

	
		
	
	
		Chat Completions API
	

The Chat Completions API can be used with most inference frameworks, as well as Qwen Cloud.
Before starting, make sure it is installed and the API key and the API base URL is configured, e.g.:
pip install -U openai

# Set the following accordingly
export OPENAI_BASE_URL="http://localhost:8000/v1"
export OPENAI_API_KEY="EMPTY"


	
		
	
	
		Text-Only Input
	

from openai import OpenAI
# Configured by environment variables
client = OpenAI()

messages = [
    {"role": "user", "content": "Write a Python function to merge two sorted linked lists."},
]

completion = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next",
    messages=messages,
    extra_body={
        "chat_template_kwargs": {
            "enable_thinking": True,  # on by default
            "preserve_thinking": True, # on by default
        },
    },
    reasoning_effort="xhigh",  # xhigh by default; supported levels are xhigh, medium, and low
    stream=True,
    stream_options={"include_usage": True},
)

reasoning_content = ""
answer_content = ""
is_answering = False
print("\n" + "=" * 20 + "Reasoning" + "=" * 20 + "\n")

for chunk in completion:
    if not chunk.choices:
        print("\nUsage:")
        print(chunk.usage)
        continue

    delta = chunk.choices[0].delta

    if hasattr(delta, "reasoning_content") and delta.reasoning_content is not None:
        if not is_answering:
            print(delta.reasoning_content, end="", flush=True)
        reasoning_content += delta.reasoning_content
    elif hasattr(delta, "reasoning") and delta.reasoning is not None:
        if not is_answering:
            print(delta.reasoning, end="", flush=True)
        reasoning_content += delta.reasoning

    if hasattr(delta, "content") and delta.content:
        if not is_answering:
            print("\n" + "=" * 20 + "Answer" + "=" * 20 + "\n")
            is_answering = True
        print(delta.content, end="", flush=True)
        answer_content += delta.content

messages.append({
    "role": "assistant",
    "content": answer_content,
    "reasoning_content": reasoning_content,
    "reasoning": reasoning_content,
})

		Disable Preserved Thinking
	

By default, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next retains thinking blocks from all historical messages, maintaining a complete reasoning trace across the conversation. This behavior, known as preserved thinking, ensures full context continuity and is especially beneficial for agent scenarios where decision consistency and reduced redundant reasoning are critical. It also improves KV cache utilization, optimizing inference efficiency in both thinking and non-thinking modes.
If you prefer to retain only the thinking blocks from the latest user message, you can disable this behavior by setting preserve_thinking to False:

# Configured by environment variables

messages = [...]

    model="Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next",
    messages=messages,
    extra_body={
        "chat_template_kwargs": {"preserve_thinking": False},
    },
)
print("Chat response:", chat_response)

		Best Practices
	

To achieve optimal performance, we recommend the following settings:

Sampling Parameters: We suggest using the following sets of sampling parameters:  

Thinking Mode: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=0.0, repetition_penalty=1.0
Instruct (or non-thinking) mode: temperature=0.7, top_p=0.80, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5, repetition_penalty=1.0

 For supported frameworks, you can adjust the presence_penalty parameter between 0 and 2 to reduce endless repetition. However, using a higher value may occasionally result in language mixing and a slight decrease in model performance.

Adequate Output Length: To optimize performance on agentic tasks, we recommend allocating sufficient output length to allow the model to generate detailed and comprehensive responses. For frameworks that support separate token limits for internal reasoning and final outputs, we suggest the following configuration within the 1M context length:

Reasoning Content: Set the maximum output length to 262,144 tokens.
Final Response: Set the maximum output length to 131,072 tokens.

 These settings provide the necessary capacity for complex reasoning while ensuring ample space for high-quality final deliverables.

Processing Ultra-Long Texts: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next natively supports context lengths of up to 262,144 tokens. For long-horizon tasks where the total length (including both input and output) exceeds this limit, we recommend using RoPE scaling techniques to handle long texts effectively, e.g., YaRN.
 YaRN is currently supported by several inference frameworks, e.g., vLLM, SGLang, and TokenSpeed. 
 In general, there are two approaches to enabling YaRN for supported frameworks:

Modifying the model configuration file:
  In the config.json file, change the rope_parameters fields in text_config to:
{
    "mrope_interleaved": true,
    "mrope_section": [
        11,
        11,
        10
    ],
    "rope_type": "yarn",
    "rope_theta": 10000000,
    "partial_rotary_factor": 0.25,
    "factor": 4.0,
    "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144
}


Passing command line arguments:
  For vLLM, you can use
VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1 vllm serve ... --hf-overrides '{"text_config": {"rope_parameters": {"mrope_interleaved": true, "mrope_section": [11, 11, 10], "rope_type": "yarn", "rope_theta": 10000000, "partial_rotary_factor": 0.25, "factor": 4.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144}}}' --max-model-len 1000000  

  For SGLang, you can use
SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1 python -m sglang.launch_server ... --json-model-override-args '{"text_config": {"rope_parameters": {"mrope_interleaved": true, "mrope_section": [11, 11, 10], "rope_type": "yarn", "rope_theta": 10000000, "partial_rotary_factor": 0.25, "factor": 4.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144}}}' --context-length 1000000

  For TokenSpeed, you can use
TOKENSPEED_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1 tokenspeed serve ... --hf-overrides '{"text_config": {"rope_parameters": {"mrope_interleaved": true, "mrope_section": [11, 11, 10], "rope_type": "yarn", "rope_theta": 10000000, "partial_rotary_factor": 0.25, "factor": 4.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144}}}' --max-model-len 1000000  




All the notable open-source frameworks implement static YaRN, which means the scaling factor remains constant regardless of input length, potentially impacting performance on shorter texts.
We advise modifying the rope_parameters configuration only when processing long contexts is required. 
It is also recommended to modify the factor as needed. For example, if the typical context length for your application is 524,288 tokens, it would be better to set factor as 2.0. 


Long Video Understanding: To optimize inference efficiency for plain text and images, the size parameter in the released video_preprocessor_config.json is conservatively configured. It is recommended to set the longest_edge parameter in the video_preprocessor_config file to 469,762,048 (corresponding to 224k video tokens) to enable higher frame-rate sampling for hour-scale videos and thereby achieve superior performance. For example,
{"longest_edge": 469762048, "shortest_edge": 4096}

 Alternatively, override the default values via engine startup parameters. For implementation details, refer to: vLLM / SGLang.

容器里直接 `pip install` 失败，是这两个原因（今晚我们都踩过）：**代理环境变量**（host 网络不共享 env，容器里 pip 出不了网）+ **PEP-668**（镜像的系统 Python 拒绝直接 pip 装包）。给你两条可走的路：

## 路线 A：进容器手工装（快速验证用）

```bash
docker run -it --rm --network host --gpus '"device=3,4"' \
  -e http_proxy=$http_proxy -e https_proxy=$https_proxy -e no_proxy=$no_proxy \
  -e HTTP_PROXY=$http_proxy -e HTTPS_PROXY=$https_proxy -e NO_PROXY=$NO_PROXY \
  -e PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES=1 \
  vllm/vllm-openai:qwen38-flash-next bash

# 容器里：
python3 -m pip install auto-round lm-eval datasets pillow
```

- 代理变量必须带（这台机器访问外网走 proxy-dmz，容器不继承环境变量）；
- `PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES=1` 对付 PEP-668 的「externally managed」拒绝；
- 如果镜像里连 pip 都没有：`python3 -m ensurepip` 先补 pip，或镜像若带 `uv` 就 `uv pip install --system ...`。

## 路线 B：装我们本地的 auto-round 源码（推荐，和今晚验证过的版本一致）

PyPI 的 auto-round 是 0.14.2（今晚量化就是它跑的），我们本地是验证过的 0.15.0-dev。要统一版本：

```bash
docker run -it --rm ...（同上）... \
  -v /home/kaokaolv/auto_agent/auto-round:/opt/auto-round \
  vllm/vllm-openai:qwen38-flash-next bash
# 容器里：
python3 -m pip install --no-build-isolation -e /opt/auto-round
```

（`--no-build-isolation` 是 auto-round 源码装的硬性要求，它的 AGENTS.md 写明。）
